alternatives.function_family: R0 fallback: isotropic gaussian kernel; mean 28.16 dB, worse than motion on every pair; kept only as a deterministic-kernel fallback if motion angle randomness is deemed undesirable

analysis.decision_basis: Same pipeline as R1 retained item-by-item -> NO_CHANGE. The pipeline is locked by bit-exact reproduction (pair2 MSE=0 / PSNR=inf, R32) and by a fresh R2 draw on pair4 (61.19 dB, CI 10/10, R39). No signal-motivated alternative candidate exists (JPEG/noise/contrast/gamma/saturation all refuted), and no new candidate can improve on an exact pipeline.
signal_sources: pair2 bit-exact: R32 blur_motion:1,brightness_darken_shfit_RGB:3 reproduced degraded_2.png with MSE=0 (PSNR=inf, CI 10/10). Bit-exactness locks function, severity and order (motion radius/sigma are fixed by severity; no other kernel family/severity yields identical pixels). R2 rerun R37 drew a different random angle (37.16 dB, CI 10/10) -> the residual gap is angle-draw variance, not parameter error

R2 fresh draw on pair4 (R39): unchanged pipeline scored 61.19 dB CI 10/10 (R1 draw: 37.56 dB) -> independently re-confirms the pipeline is exact; per-pair PSNR spread comes from the random motion angle in x_distortion

compression refuted: block_boundary=0.9935 pair0 / 1.0068 pair1 (<1.05), R2 CI unique_G diff=0-1 on all 5 pairs; unique_G=203 follows arithmetically from the additive RGB shift sev3 (256-51 levels minus clipping), not JPEG; adding JPEG lowered PSNR in R0 (34.17/35.54 dB)

noise refuted: noise_prior sigma=0.74 (pair0) and 1.48 (pair1 peeled), both <2; peeled_noise_check_R2 on the exact locking pipeline gives extreme_pct=74.99%, vm_slope=0.6969, spatial_corr=0.9758, rgb_ratio=1.2502 with sigma<5 -> SKILL known false-positive rule (JPEG/blur artifact); bit-exact pair2 excludes any random-noise step

global retained: mean_shift -36.3/-43.9/-46.1/-49.0/-49.3 monotonic with clipped_fraction 0.494/0.357/0.242/0.132/0.103, unique_G=203 in every pair/channel; variance_ratio 0.657-0.851 is explained by darkening+zero clipping (contrast_from_variance=false, brightness_clip_explains_variance=true) -> additive brightness_darken_shfit_RGB:3, not contrast/gamma

pair4 saturation_weaken_sev3 flag (saturation_chroma_ratio=0.8397, saturation_detected_raw=true) ruled out as a companion effect of additive shift + clipping: the bit-exact reproduction contains no saturation step and R39 reached 61.19 dB, leaving no room for a third degradation

motion rule: pair1 residual after peeling brightness_darken_shfit_RGB:3 has residual_anisotropy=2.198 (>1.7, SKILL 94% recall/0% FP) and verdict MOTION_BLUR; severity=1 is fixed by the bit-exact reproduction
analysis.rationale: R2 re-examined every signal flagged by run_full_analysis_R2 (compression, blur, noise, global) plus the pair4 saturation flag and found no evidence for any additional or alternative degradation. blur_motion:1 + brightness_darken_shfit_RGB:3 reproduced pair2 bit-exactly (MSE=0), which uniquely pins function/severity/order. Five fresh support reruns of the unchanged pipeline all hit CI 10/10 (37.52 / 24.39 / 37.16 / 26.24 / 61.19 dB, mean 37.30 vs R0 28.16), with pair4 exceeding 40 dB. The R1-to-R2 per-pair PSNR differences are the random motion-angle draw inside x_distortion, not a parameter error, so the trained-model support PSNR (30.66 dB) is limited by angle stochasticity and the 2-epoch budget rather than by the blind-ID pipeline. No new candidate was generated; with an exact pipeline a CHANGE has no support.
analysis.caveat: x_distortion draws a random motion angle per simulation call; identical pipelines scored 17.64-61.19 dB on the same support pair across draws (all CI 10/10). The parameter set (function + severity) is exact; the angle is not encodable in predicted params.
